changes: p1 name corrected from 'Jayajitāmitramalla' to 'Sumatijayajitāmitramalla' (the full Bhaktapur regnal style of Jitāmitra Malla, as in the catalogue field); 'sumati' removed from titles because it belongs to the regnal name, not a title
p2 confidence lowered to medium: 'pramaāna' is read as the Newar office title pramāṇa/pramāna (headman or official). He is named only to mark the time ('velasa'), so the minister role is tentative
ce_approx changed from 1690 to 1689: Kārttika śukla 9 of NS 810 falls in Oct/Nov 1689, because the NS year begins in Kārttika
notes rewritten: Newari parsing and dating

notes: The colophon is in Newari. It reads roughly '[Sumatijaya]jitāmitramalladeva-sana (agentive) dhā(?) pustaka dayakā (had made) Bhagirāma pramāṇa-yā velasa (at the time of)'. 'jayatitāmitra' is a corrupt spelling of jayajitāmitra, and 'malladea' of malladeva. The king is Jitāmitra Malla of Bhaktapur (r. c. 1673–1696), whose full style is Sumatijayajitāmitramalla. 'dhā' is unclear: it may be a corruption of thva ('this') or part of a word for the type of text. 'pramaāna' is taken as the office title pramāṇa/pramāna; Bhagirāma's exact office is uncertain. NS 810 is consistent with Jitāmitra's reign. The place is not stated, but Bhaktapur is likely given the king.
